capabilities: A general lightweight text model, rather than a particular provider or model ID. Usually suitable for clear, self-contained short rewriting, summarization, extraction, translation, basic arithmetic, straightforward explanations, and routine factual questions when sufficient context is supplied. Assess the actual requirements, not prompt length or keywords alone: a short proof can be difficult, and a longer structured extraction can be routine. Prefer needs_big for difficult multi-step reasoning, subtle debugging, complex design, rigorous proofs, or tasks where a material mistake is costly. Use uncertain when references, context, or capability assumptions are insufficient. Assume no external tools, browsing, attachments, image or video generation. This capability class is generalized from a Haiku/Sonnet benchmark; adequacy of each provider target has not been measured. Do not assume tools or context exist merely because the user asks for them.
threshold_basis: Provisional transfer of the existing Haiku/Sonnet development threshold (0.69 plus 0.02 margin). General capability wording and cross-provider mappings change the classifier input and have not been separately calibrated.
evidence_note: General guidance using the existing 0.71 threshold provisionally. Original Haiku/Sonnet synthetic test: 15 suggestions, 14 graded, 0 harmful among those 14; not measured cross-provider accuracy or savings.
